artworks.title: Louis XIII, King of France
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person depicted from the chest up, facing the viewer. The individual has curly hair, styled off the forehead. The facial features include sharp eyebrows, a rounded nose, and slightly pursed lips. They are wearing detailed and ornate attire, including a ruffled collar and elaborate garments. The oval frame surrounding the portrait has inscriptions in Latin. Below the portrait, a decorative section contains intricate designs like a shield, helmet, and a central motif of a tree with the word "DAMNOSA" above it. The background has cross-hatched textures, adding to the depth and detail of the engraving.

artworks.title: Frances Howard, Duchess of Richmond
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated beside a table with an open book. She is positioned with her body turned slightly to the right, with one hand resting on the edge of the table and the other touching the pages of the book. The woman has a fair complexion, large eyes, and a calm expression. Her hair is styled high with feathers and jewels. She wears a dress with elaborate embroidery, lace, a lace ruff collar and cuffs, floral designs, and ribbons. She wears a necklace and holds a small round object in her left hand. In the background is a partially drawn curtain and a coat of arms hanging on the left side. The tablecloth is ornately patterned.

artworks.title: Frances Howard, Duchess of Richmond
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing, with her left hand on a pedestal and her right arm at her waist. She has an oval face, defined brows, and a small mouth. She is wearing a dress with lace cuffs, floral embroidery, and pearls. Her hair is styled in waves, and she holds an object in her left hand. Next to her on the pedestal is a small animal. The background is dark with vertical lines suggesting a curtain.

artworks.title: Darcy Wentworth
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man from the waist up. He is positioned slightly turned to his left but looks directly at the viewer. His facial features include arched eyebrows, deep-set eyes, a prominent nose, and a pointed beard and mustache. His hair is voluminous, curly, and extends outward, framing his face. He is dressed in a high-collared outfit typical of the 17th century, adorned with intricate patterns and buttons. The collar is large, with lace edging. He appears to be wearing ornate armor over a richly decorated cloth garment. No visible jewelry is present, and he holds no objects. In the top right corner of the image, there is a coat of arms alongside inscriptions, including the year "1624". The background is plain, emphasizing the detailed engraving of the man.

artworks.title: Title Page, A Thankful Remembrance of God's Mercie, by George Carleton
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring a central figure crowned and holding a banner inscribed with the phrase "Ecclesiastes 1.4 vera." Around this figure are various allegorical elements, including angels holding scrolls with messages, biblical figures labeled "Deborah" and "Salomon," and symbols like ships and churches. The banner at the bottom states "A Thankfull Remembrance of Gods Mercie by G.C."

artworks.title: Catherine Manners, Duchess of Buckingham
artworks.artist: Magdalena de Passe and Willem de Passe
artworks.description: The image features a bust-length portrait of a woman in period attire with a composed expression. Her hair is styled elegantly, and she holds a fan in her hands. Flanking the portrait are full-length depictions of men in period attire, alongside scenes of hunting and jousting. The background depicts pastoral landscapes.

artworks.title: Catherine Manners, Duchess of Buckingham
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a woman facing forward. She has prominent eyes, a small nose, and a closed mouth. Her round face is framed by shoulder-length wavy hair. She wears a detailed garment with a high lace collar and a dress with intricate patterns and ruffles. The woman holds a large feathered fan in her right hand. The background has a finely hatched texture, and text at the bottom identifies her as "Lady Katherin Marchioness of Buckingham."

artworks.title: Robert Cecil, First Earl of Salisbury, Lord Treasurer
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a historical figure in an oval frame as part of an intricate engraving. The figure faces slightly to the right, with a gaze towards the audience. Features include a forehead, eyebrows, eyes, mustache, goatee, and hair styled back with a wave. The figure wears elaborate attire with a ruff collar and a doublet. No jewelry or objects are visible. The background includes engravings and inscriptions, with scrollwork around the frame. Text below the image details the individual's titles and achievements, alongside a coat of arms. The piece has an aged, historical aesthetic blending portraiture and text.

artworks.title: Robert Cecil, First Earl of Salisbury
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraved portrait of a person from the chest up in a formal pose. The individual is shown wearing a high, lace-edged ruff around their neck, typical of early 17th-century fashion. The facial features include a mustache and a small beard, with medium-length hair styled back. They are dressed in an ornate, buttoned garment with visible stripes on the shoulders. Surrounding the portrait is an oval frame with inscriptions in Latin identifying the person as Robert Cecil, Earl of Salisbury. In the background, there is an intricate pattern within the oval frame, and beneath the portrait is an inscription detailing his titles and achievements, along with a prominently displayed coat of arms. The artwork displays a classical engraving style with fine, detailed linework.

artworks.title: James I
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of an individual. The person is positioned facing slightly to the right with their head turned towards the viewer. They have curly, shoulder-length hair, a medium-length mustache, and a short beard. The individual has a serious expression, with well-defined eyes and features. They are wearing an elaborate outfit with ornate detailing, including a high, stiff ruff around the neck, straps with decorative elements, and a garment that has a series of embellished patterns. A wide-brimmed hat adorned with a plume sits atop the head. In the background are depictions of mythological figures within the oval border that frames the portrait, including Apollo on the upper left side and a figure possibly representing Minerva on the upper right. Below the portrait, there is a bordered section with inscriptions in Latin. The background is intricately hatched, providing depth and emphasizing the figure's prominence.

artworks.title: Alexander the Great Receiving a Sword (?)
artworks.description: Drawing of a historical scene showing two groups exchanging objects. On the left, individuals in decorative clothing and ruffs face a group in armor with swords and shields on the right. In the center, a person in ornate armor gestures towards another armored figure holding a sheathed sword. Above them, an angelic figure looks down. The lower part includes a scroll with text. The style resembles historical engravings, focusing on fabric and armor details.

artworks.title: Arabella Stuart
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a woman from the waist up. She is seated facing forward with her body turned slightly to her left. Her facial features are detailed with a long, narrow face, high arched eyebrows, prominent nose, and small lips. Her hair is styled elaborately, pulled back and adorned with an intricate hairpiece. The woman is dressed in opulent clothing with a high lace ruffled collar and sleeves, richly patterned fabric, and decorative tassels. She wears multiple strands of necklaces and has a decorative pin or brooch at her chest. In her hands, she holds an open book. The background features a decorative border with swirling ribbon-like designs, a heraldic shield at the top, and an inscription framing her portrait. The engraving has a monochrome palette.

artworks.title: Prince Henry, Lord Darnley, King of Scotland
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait engraving of a young man seated facing forward. He has a solemn expression with arched brows and closed lips. He wears a hat with a large plume, a round ruff around his neck, a high-collared garment with detailed fabric, a mantle with shoulder pads, and a medallion on a ribbon around his neck. The background has hatched shading, an oval border with Latin script, and decorative patterns. Detailed inscriptions at the top and bottom provide context about the individual.

artworks.title: Francis White, D.D., Bishop of Ely
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up, sitting at a desk. He is facing slightly to his left, with his head turned towards the viewer. The man has distinct facial features and is dressed in clothing typical of the period. He is writing with a quill pen on a piece of paper, with books on the desk around him. The background is decorative, with a framed oval surrounding his head and an eagle holding a ribbon above it. Latin text surrounds the frame, and additional text is inscribed below the image.

artworks.title: Richard Elton
artworks.description: The image features a male figure shown from the waist up. He has shoulder-length, wavy hair, a moustache, and a goatee. The man is wearing an armor suit and holding a staff or baton. Around him are ornate decorative elements including banners, flags, and weapons. The background is intricately engraved with symbolic motifs and inscriptions.

artworks.title: Pyrotechnia
artworks.description: This is a cover page design for a book about pyrotechnics. The image features elements associated with pyrotechnic displays and mechanical devices. At the center is a title block announcing the book as "Pyrotechnia Or a Discourse of artificial Fireworks for Pleasure." Surrounding the text block are various illustrations: scenes of castles, knights, serpents, and a dragon entwined with fireworks or flames at the top, and mechanical devices in the corners and gaps, including a geared mechanism, a sundial, and other technical apparatuses. At the bottom center, there is a portrait of a man in period attire, likely the author, John Babington, with an inscription surrounding it.

artworks.title: Frontispiece to Complaint of the False Prophets, by John de La Marche
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ancient map. The map contains various regions with labeled names such as "Moab," "Aram," and "Egypt," alongside natural features like the "Red Sea." The map is bordered by two architectural pillars on either side and topped with elaborate script titles and descriptions. Additionally, it includes a large compass rose, illustrations, and symbolic representations. The text atop reads, "A Complaint of the False Prophets Marine upon the drying up of their Hierarchical Euphrates." Below the map, biblical quotations are referenced.

artworks.title: Frontispiece to Truth Brought to Light by Time
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an allegorical scene representing the concept of truth being uncovered. The central figures include a partially draped female figure pulling back a curtain, and a male figure with a radiant symbol on his chest holding a scythe. Both seem to symbolize the personifications of time and truth. Between them stands a seated regal figure beneath a canopied throne. Below this scene unfolds a narrative in smaller scenes featuring scholarly individuals engaged in study and writing, stacks of books, and scrolls suggesting the gathering and dissemination of knowledge. On the right side, the centerpiece is a tree with books and rolled parchments hanging from the branches. The artwork is ornately lined and illustratively engraved, revealing a rich tapestry of symbolism pertaining to enlightenment and historical integrity.

artworks.title: Queen Elizabeth
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing in a side view. She has a halo around her head and wears a crown. She has a composed expression with wavy hair styled away from her face, and is dressed in a long gown with patterns and a necklace. She stands next to a table with an open book and holds a scroll. Two angels hold a crown above her, with text that reads, "Many daughters have done well but thou surpassest them all." The background includes a medieval cityscape labeled "Woodstock," with towers and buildings, as well as clouds.

artworks.title: John Foxe, Author of Book of Martyrs
artworks.description: The engraving depicts a man with an elongated face, deeply set eyes, a prominent nose, and angular brows. He has a long, pointed beard and is wearing a dark, wide-brimmed hat. His attire includes a fur-collared coat over a pleated shirt. The intricately detailed fabric texture is visible. The portrait is framed with engraved text. In the background, there is a finely lined texture. Below the portrait, a decorative inscription identifies the individual as Mr. John Foxe.

artworks.title: James, Second Marquis of Hamilton
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing in a dignified posture. He is positioned to the right of the image, with his right arm slightly raised and bent at the elbow, resting his hand on the table, while his left hand holds a slender staff. The man's face is characterized by a prominent mustache, a strong angular jawline, and slightly wavy, shoulder-length hair. He is wearing an elaborate outfit consisting of a high ruffled collar, ornate armor plating covering the torso and arms, and voluminous, patterned breeches. His footwear consists of tall boots with intricate details. He stands next to a table with a richly decorated cloth, on which rests an elaborate helmet adorned with plumes. The background is filled by heavy draped curtains, with a detailed, crosshatched pattern on the floor.

artworks.title: John Howson, Bishop of Durham
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man seated from the waist up. He has an aged face with a long white beard and a mustache. His hair is covered by a cap. He wears historical European clergy attire with a dark robe, rounded shoulders, and a high collar. The oval border around him contains a Latin inscription, and there are heraldic shields in the corners. The background is filled with detailed lines typical of intaglio engraving. Below the portrait, there is an engraved panel with English text.

artworks.title: Mountjoy Blount, First Earl of Newport
artworks.description: The central portrait shows a person from the waist up, positioned with their body turned slightly to the side and their face looking directly at the viewer. They have delicate facial features with arched eyebrows, a pointed nose, and slightly parted lips. Their hair is curly and styled with some volume, and they are wearing a large, wide-brimmed hat. The person is dressed in formal attire, featuring a richly detailed doublet with a lace collar, and they have a sash across their chest. They are adorned with earrings that are visible beneath their hair. Surrounding the central portrait are various illustrations, including figures in elaborate clothing typical of the period, shown standing and engaged in activities such as hunting and jousting. The background consists of detailed engravings, depicting scenes of hunting with dogs and a jousting match, showcasing the activities and fashion of the era.

artworks.title: Henry Frederick, Prince of Wales
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of Henry, Prince of Wales, depicted in an oval frame with only the head and part of the shoulders visible. He is positioned facing forward with a composed expression, featuring prominent eyes, a straight nose, and a stoic mouth. His hair is styled away from his face, curled and voluminous at the top. The prince is attired in a high, elaborate lace collar characteristic of the period, and his clothing suggests armor, denoting nobility. Surrounding the oval frame are allegorical figures; a helmeted woman in armor holding a spear stands to the left. On the right, another draped female figure holds a staff. Above the portrait, two cherubs hold a laurel wreath and a shield adorned with three feathers, while a drapery-like canopy tops the composition. The backdrop and elements of the border contribute to the regal atmosphere.
